_comment: The grammar terms the app names, in one place. On a tag the Arabic term stands alone: مبتدأ, منصوب. Its English is here, in the glossary at the foot of the Nahw page. 'types' and 'cases' are keyed by the string the backend sends and also give the tags their Arabic. 'sections' are the glossary itself, titled and ordered by Tasheel al-Nahw's own chapters; a section with 'from' lists that group above. One entry per idea: a label that is a form of another (اسم ليس, اسم كان مؤخر) is named in that entry's meaning, not given its own. tests/test_rule_engine.py checks every role, tarkeeb term and label in the book's worked examples has an entry or is named in one. lib/grammarTerms.js is the only reader.

ism.meaning: A noun: a person, thing, place, quality or name. It takes case endings.

fi'l.meaning: A verb: something done, in past, present or command form. The past form never changes its ending; the present one does.

harf.meaning: A particle: a small word with no meaning of its own until joined to others, such as في, و, لم. Its ending never changes.

damir.meaning: A pronoun: هو, أنت, or one attached to a word like the ـه in كتابه. It is a kind of اسم.

zarf.meaning: A word for when or where: قبل, عند, فوق. It is a kind of اسم.

raf'.meaning: The ending for a subject: a ضمة on one noun, و on a sound masculine plural.

nasb.meaning: The ending for an object and for what comes after إن: a فتحة on one noun.

jarr.meaning: The ending after a preposition or as the second word of a مضاف pair: a كسرة on one noun.

jazm.meaning: The ending of a present verb after لم, the لا that forbids, the لام of command and their like: a سكون, or a dropped final letter. A verb in this state is a فعل مجزوم.

mabni.meaning: Fixed. The ending never changes whatever the word is doing: past verbs, pronouns, particles.

terms.meaning: A sentence that starts with a noun: الطالب مجتهد.
A sentence that starts with a verb: كتب الطالب.
A sentence that tells something, so it can be true or false: a جملة اسمية خبرية or a جملة فعلية خبرية.
A sentence that does not tell but asks, calls, wonders, swears or commands, so it cannot be true or false.
A sentence that asks a question.
A particle that asks: هل, أ.
A sentence that calls someone with يا, as in يا محمد.
A sentence that wonders at something, as in ما أحسنَ زيدًا.
The verb of wonder, on the pattern ما أفعلَ or أفعِلْ بـ.
A sentence that swears by something, as in واللهِ.
The و, ب or ت of swearing.
What is sworn by, such as the word الله after the و of واللهِ. It is مجرور.
What a جار ومجرور or a ظرف hangs on: the verb (متعلق بالفعل), or a خبر left unsaid (متعلق بالخبر).
A و or ف that starts a fresh sentence rather than joining a word to the one before.
What a جملة اسمية is about. It is مرفوع. When the خبر is itself a جملة اسمية, that clause has a second one, called مبتدأ ثان.
What is said about the مبتدأ, as in الطالب مجتهدٌ. It is مرفوع.
كان or one of its sisters (صار, أصبح, أمسى, ليس and others). It comes before a مبتدأ and خبر and makes the خبر become منصوب.
The مبتدأ after كان or a sister, named after it (اسم ليس, اسم صار, اسم أمسى). It stays مرفوع. When it comes after its خبر it is called اسم كان مؤخر.
The خبر after كان or a sister, named after it (خبر ليس, خبر صار, خبر أمسى). It becomes منصوب. When it comes before its اسم it is called خبر كان مقدم.
إن or one of its sisters (أن, كأن, لكن, ليت, لعل). It comes before a مبتدأ and خبر and makes the مبتدأ become منصوب.
The مبتدأ after إن or a sister, named after it (اسم ليت, اسم لعل). It becomes منصوب.
The خبر after إن or a sister, named after it (خبر ليت, خبر لعل). It stays مرفوع.
After ظن or a sister (حسب, علم, رأى), the first of its two objects: what was the مبتدأ. It is منصوب.
After ظن or a sister, the second object: what was the خبر. Also منصوب.
The لا that denies a whole kind, as in لا ريبَ فيه. It works like إن. Also written لا لنفي الجنس.
The noun after لا. After the لا that denies a kind it is منصوب, or مبني on a فتحة when it is one word.
What is said after لا about its اسم. After the لا that denies a kind it is مرفوع.
The ما that denies the way ليس does, as in ما هذا بشرًا. Its خبر is منصوب. Also called ما المشبهة بليس.
A لا that denies the way ليس does. Its خبر is منصوب.
The noun after the ما that works like ليس. It stays مرفوع.
What is said after that ما. It becomes منصوب.
كاد or one of its sisters (أوشك, عسى and others): something nearly or about to happen. Its خبر is a present verb.
The مبتدأ after كاد. It stays مرفوع.
The present verb after كاد saying what nearly happened.
A word like الذي or التي that a clause after it describes.
The clause after a اسم موصول that completes it, as in الذي نجحَ.
A اسم موصول and its صلة read together as one unit.
A pointing word: هذا, هذه, ذلك, تلك.
The noun pointed at, after a اسم الإشارة.
A اسم الإشارة and its مشار إليه read together as one unit, as in هذا الكتاب.
A number from 11 to 19 made of two words joined as one, as in أحد عشر. Both parts (جزء أول, جزء ثان) are مبني on a فتحة.
The one doing the verb, as in كتب الطالبُ. It is مرفوع.
A doer not written but understood inside the verb, such as the أنت in اكتبْ.
A verb and its doer read together as one unit.
A passive verb, whose doer is not named, as in كُتِبَ.
The word standing in for the doer after a فعل مجهول, as in كُتِبَ الدرسُ. It is مرفوع. Also written نائب الفاعل.
The one the verb is done to, as in كتب الطالب الدرسَ.
The one called after يا, as in يا محمدُ. It is منصوب when it is the first word of a مضاف pair, otherwise usually مبني on a ضمة.
A calling particle: يا, أيها.
The verb's own noun repeated to stress it or say how, as in ضربته ضربًا.
Why the verb was done, as in قمت احترامًا (out of respect). Also called مفعول لأجله.
What the verb happened alongside, after a و meaning 'with', as in سرت والنيلَ.
When or where the verb happened, as in سافرت ليلًا.
A مفعول فيه that says when: يومَ, ليلًا, قبلَ.
A مفعول فيه that says where: عندَ, فوقَ, أمامَ.
The state someone was in while the verb happened, as in جاء راكبًا. It has no ال.
A word that makes a vague one clear, as in عشرون كتابًا. It has no ال.
The one left out after إلا, as in جاء القوم إلا زيدًا.
The particle that leaves something out: إلا.
A preposition: في, على, من, إلى, بـ, لـ. The noun after it is مجرور.
A preposition and the noun after it, read together as one unit, as in في البيتِ.
The first word of an 'X of Y' pair, as in كتابُ الطالب. It takes no ال.
The second word of an 'X of Y' pair, as in كتاب الطالبِ. Always مجرور.
A مضاف and its مضاف إليه read together as one unit.
The noun a صفة describes.
Describes the noun before it and copies its gender, number, ال and ending, as in الطالبُ المجتهدُ. Also called نعت.
A موصوف and its صفة read together as one unit.
A word that stresses the one before it and copies its ending, as in جاء القوم كلُّهم.
A word that renames the one before it and copies its ending, as in جاء أخوك زيدٌ.
A joining word: و, ف, ثم, أو.
The word after a حرف عطف. It copies the ending of the word it is joined to.
A command verb, as in اكتبْ. It is مبني.
A particle that says 'not': لا, ما, لم, لن. After لم the verb is مجزوم; after لن it is منصوب.
The لا that forbids, as in لا تكتبْ. The verb after it is مجزوم.

_corpus_pos_comment: The Quranic corpus files every word as N, V or P. Each names the type above it prints as.
